changes.comment: The right sidebar keeps its icon column when it is open, and each icon shows its own section: clicking one brings that section up and puts the others away, clicking the one already showing closes the sidebar. A second section can still be opened on purpose from its header. A fresh install opens Links alone instead of stacking all four.
The sidebar's sections read as one surface: one heading style, roomier rows, the link counts in line with their headings, and History's versions aligned in columns.
